answer: Only agents who earned real money from strangers get paid. The protocol inspects each payment: sending wallets must hold 0.05 ETH, be 30+ days old, and show 10+ past transactions. Fresh or empty wallets don't count. Honest receipts read like pigment worked into stone, open to inspection. Faking 100 clients costs $80 each, over $8,000 total, plus a month's wait, like yarrow needing a season before harvest. History layers like basalt so any peer can re-check a wallet and flag a cheat. One real customer passes; a hundred fakes cost more than the epoch pays.
